about_zh: 手机与平板上的应用、框架和自动化。

repos.description: Display and control your Android device
repos.summary_zh: scrcpy 是一款高性能、低延迟的 Android 设备屏幕镜像与控制工具，支持 USB/TCP 连接，无需 root 或额外应用。具备 30~120fps 流畅传输、1920×1080 高清画质、35~70ms 低延迟、1 秒内启动等特性，并提供音频转发、录制、虚拟显示、键盘鼠标模拟、游戏手柄支持等丰富功能，适用于 Linux、Windows、macOS 三大平台。
repos.summary_en: scrcpy is a lightweight, high-performance Android device mirroring and control tool that supports USB/TCP connections without requiring root access or additional apps. It delivers 30~120fps video at 1920×1080+ quality with 35~70ms latency and sub-second startup. Features include audio forwarding, recording, virtual display, HID keyboard/mouse simulation, gamepad support, and more, available on Linux, Windows, and macOS.

repos.description: The Magic Mask for Android
repos.summary_zh: Magisk 是一款专为 Android 6.0+ 设备设计的开源定制工具，提供系统级 root 权限、模块化功能扩展及 Zygisk 动态注入能力，支持在不修改系统分区的情况下深度定制设备，广泛用于解锁系统限制、安装模块和高级调试。
repos.summary_en: Magisk is an open-source suite for customizing Android devices above Android 6.0, offering root access via MagiskSU, systemless modification through modules, and Zygisk for runtime code injection, enabling deep customization without altering system partitions.

repos.description: An awesome list that curates the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, articles and more.
repos.summary_zh: Solido/awesome-flutter 是一个精选的 Flutter 资源库，涵盖最佳库、工具、教程、文章等，为开发者提供全面的 Flutter 开发指南，助力跨平台应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Solido/awesome-flutter is a curated list of the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, and articles, serving as a comprehensive resource for Flutter developers to build cross-platform applications.

repos.description: A powerful 🚀 Android chart view / graph view library, supporting line- bar- pie- radar- bubble- and candlestick charts as well as scaling, panning and animations.
repos.summary_zh: MPAndroidChart 是一个功能强大且易于使用的 Android 图表库，支持折线图、柱状图、饼图、雷达图、气泡图和 K 线图等多种图表类型，具备缩放、平移和动画功能，适用于数据可视化场景。
repos.summary_en: MPAndroidChart is a powerful and easy-to-use Android chart library supporting line, bar, pie, radar, bubble, and candlestick charts with scaling, panning, and animations for data visualization.

repos.description: A categorized collection of Android Open Source Projects,  More powerful web version:
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是 Android 开源项目的权威分类汇总，涵盖 UI、网络、数据库等 250+ 个精选项目，提供个性化控件、工具库及优质案例。配套开发助手 App 支持反编译、布局分析、屏幕取色等开发调试功能，官网 timeshining.com 提供最新项目搜索与推送服务。
repos.summary_en: This repository is a comprehensive categorized collection of 250+ high-quality Android open-source projects, covering UI components, toolkits, and outstanding apps. It includes a powerful Development Tools app for reverse engineering, layout inspection, color sampling, and debugging. The companion website offers project discovery and updates.

repos.description: Resume template for Chinese programmers . 程序员简历模板系列。包括PHP程序员简历模板、iOS程序员简历模板、Android程序员简历模板、Web前端程序员简历模板、Java程序员简历模板、C/C++程序员简历模板、NodeJS程序员简历模板、架构师简历模板以及通用程序员简历模板
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供涵盖PHP、iOS、Android、Web前端、Java、C/C++、NodeJS、架构师等9类程序员岗位的中文简历模板，支持Markdown格式，由AI职业顾问职小兔®优化设计。配套提供在线简历工具冷熊简历与自建版DeerResume，并附《如何写好技术简历》教学资源，助力程序员高效打造专业简历。
repos.summary_en: This repo offers 9 resume templates for Chinese programmers, covering PHP, iOS, Android, Web Frontend, Java, C/C++, NodeJS, and Architect roles in Markdown format, optimized by AI career advisor 职小兔®. It includes tools like Cold Bear Resume and DeerResume, plus teaching resources on writing effective tech resumes to help developers build professional profiles.

repos.description: flutter 开发者帮助 APP，包含 flutter 常用 140+ 组件的demo 演示与中文文档
repos.summary_zh: FlutterGo 是阿里巴巴推出的 Flutter 开发者辅助应用，提供 140+ 组件的中文文档与演示，帮助开发者快速掌握 Flutter 开发。因团队调整暂停维护，但计划未来迭代并招募社区贡献者。
repos.summary_en: FlutterGo is an Alibaba-developed Flutter developer helper app featuring 140+ component demos and Chinese documentation. It aids developers in mastering Flutter. Due to internal restructuring, maintenance is temporarily paused, with plans for future updates and community contributions.

repos.description: React Native指南汇集了各类react-native学习资源、开源App和组件
repos.summary_zh: React Native学习指南是一个全面的中文资源库，汇集了React Native开发教程、开源APP案例、组件库、工具链及权威文档，覆盖从入门到原生模块开发的完整技术栈，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: The React Native Learning Guide is a comprehensive Chinese resource hub compiling tutorials, open-source apps, components, tools, and official documentation for React Native development, covering everything from beginner guides to native module integration for cross-platform mobile app creation.

repos.description: A simple app to use Xposed without root, unlock the bootloader or modify system image, etc.
repos.summary_zh: VirtualXposed 是一款基于 VirtualApp 和 epic 技术的 Android 应用，无需 root、解锁 bootloader 或修改系统镜像即可运行 Xposed 模块。支持 Android 5.0~10.0，适用于绝大多数非系统级修改的模块，如广告拦截、功能增强等。用户可在虚拟环境中独立安装应用与模块，并通过内置重启功能快速生效，极大提升了 Android 系统的灵活性与可玩性。
repos.summary_en: VirtualXposed is an Android app built on VirtualApp and epic that enables Xposed module usage without root, bootloader unlock, or system image modification. It supports Android 5.0–10.0 and works with most non-system modules like ad blockers and app enhancements. Users can install apps and modules in a virtual environment and reboot within the app for instant activation, offering a safe and flexible way to customize Android without system-level changes.

repos.description: Swift Featured Projects in brain Mapping
repos.summary_zh: 本项目精选 Swift 开源项目，聚焦应用架构与思维导图形式呈现，涵盖主流开发工具、框架及实践案例，助力开发者快速掌握 Swift 生态。内容持续更新，强调项目影响力、可持续性与实用性，适合中高级开发者参考。
repos.summary_en: This project curates high-quality Swift open-source projects with a focus on application architecture and mind maps. It covers frameworks, tools, and best practices, providing a structured reference for Swift developers. Content emphasizes influence, sustainability, and practicality, targeting intermediate to advanced developers.

repos.description: Automation&Workflow JavaScript IDE on Android(安卓平台上的JavaScript编程IDE)
repos.summary_zh: Auto.js (Pro) 是一款专为 Android 设计的 JavaScript IDE，专注于编程学习与效率提升，支持自动化脚本开发与工作流管理，提供丰富的 API 和可视化工具，适用于移动端自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Auto.js (Pro) is a JavaScript-based IDE for Android, designed for programming education and productivity enhancement. It enables automation scripting and workflow management with rich APIs and visual tools, ideal for mobile automation tasks.

repos.description: Modern Xposed Framework
repos.summary_zh: Vector Framework 是一款基于 LSPlant 的高性能 ART hooking 框架，专为现代 Android 系统设计。作为 Zygisk 模块运行，它提供与原始 Xposed 兼容的 API，支持 Android 8.1 至 17 Beta 版本。该框架通过内存级修改实现系统与应用行为的非侵入式调整，无需修改 APK，具备可逆性和跨 ROM 兼容性。
repos.summary_en: Vector Framework is a high-performance ART hooking framework for modern Android, built on LSPlant and designed as a Zygisk module. It maintains API compatibility with legacy Xposed while supporting Android 8.1 through 17 Beta. The framework enables non-destructive in-memory modifications to system and app behavior without altering APKs, ensuring reversibility and broad ROM compatibility.

repos.description: Command-line tool that allows you to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS, and macOS apps on the App Store, and download .ipa or macOS .pkg app packages.
repos.summary_zh: ipatool 是一款跨平台命令行工具，支持从 App Store 搜索并下载 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用的 IPA 包。提供认证、搜索、授权获取、版本管理等核心功能，适用于开发者自动化部署、企业级应用分发及批量下载场景。
repos.summary_en: ipatool is a cross-platform command-line tool for searching and downloading iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS app packages (IPA) from the App Store. It supports authentication, search, license acquisition, and version management, ideal for developer workflows, enterprise distribution, and batch app management.

repos.description: Android官方培训课程中文版
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是 Google Android 官方培训课程《Android Training》的中文协作翻译版本，涵盖 Android 应用开发核心知识体系，由社区开发者共同维护。提供在线阅读与在线编辑功能，支持纠错与内容完善，是学习 Android 开发的优质中文资源。
repos.summary_en: This project is the Chinese translation of Google's official Android Training course, collaboratively translated by the community. It covers core Android development topics, offering online reading and editing support for corrections and improvements, serving as a valuable Chinese resource for Android developers.

repos.description: Modern Xposed Framework
repos.summary_zh: LSPosed 是一个基于 Zygisk 的 ART 钩子框架，旨在提供与经典 Xposed 框架一致的 API 体验。它利用 LSPlant 实现核心 ART 方法钩取，支持 Android 8.1 至 16 系统，兼容原版 Xposed 模块，无需修改 APK 即可动态修改系统和应用行为，适用于 Magisk 环境。
repos.summary_en: LSPosed is an ART hooking framework based on Zygisk that delivers consistent APIs with the original Xposed. It leverages LSPlant for core ART method hooking, supports Android 8.1–16, and is fully compatible with legacy Xposed modules, enabling dynamic system and app behavior modification without APK changes in a Magisk environment.

repos.description: Automate your mobile devices with natural language commands - an LLM agnostic mobile Agent 🤖
repos.summary_zh: Mobilerun 是一个强大的移动端自动化框架，支持通过自然语言命令控制 Android 和 iOS 设备。它基于 LLM 代理技术，提供多步骤任务规划、截图分析和跨平台支持，兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等多种大模型，适用于复杂设备交互自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Mobilerun is a powerful framework for controlling Android and iOS devices via natural language commands using LLM agents. It supports multi-step task planning, screenshot analysis, and works with multiple LLM providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini, enabling complex mobile automation through visual understanding.

repos.description: Automate your mobile devices with natural language commands - an LLM agnostic mobile Agent 🤖
repos.summary_zh: DroidRun 是一个强大的移动端自动化框架，通过 LLM 智能体实现自然语言控制 Android 和 iOS 设备。支持多模型提供商（OpenAI、Anthropic 等），具备复杂任务规划能力，提供 CLI 工具和 Python API，集成截图分析与执行追踪，实现高效移动端自动化。
repos.summary_en: DroidRun is a powerful framework for controlling Android and iOS devices via LLM agents using natural language commands. It supports multiple LLM providers, offers planning capabilities for complex tasks, includes a CLI tool with debugging features, and integrates screenshot analysis and execution tracing for mobile automation.

repos.description: 收集整理Android开发所需的Android SDK、开发中用到的工具、Android开发教程、Android设计规范，免费的设计素材等。
repos.summary_zh: AndroidDevTools 是一个专注于 Android 开发的一站式资源平台，提供 Android SDK、开发工具、设计规范、教程及素材的整合。涵盖从开发环境搭建、代码生成、资源处理到设计协作的全流程工具链，支持 Android Studio、Gradle 等主流技术栈，助力开发者高效构建高质量应用。
repos.summary_en: AndroidDevTools is a comprehensive platform for Android developers, offering curated resources including Android SDK, development tools, design guidelines, tutorials, and free assets. It covers the full development lifecycle—from environment setup and code generation to resource optimization and UI design—supporting major tools like Android Studio and Gradle to enhance productivity.

repos.description: 1 script run the vphone
repos.summary_zh: 一键脚本在 macOS 上通过 Tart 虚拟机运行已越狱的 iOS 26.1 环境（vphone），内置完整 bootstrap 和 APT 源。只需一条命令即可启动，支持 VNC 远程连接桌面，适合测试、开发验证及研究用途。
repos.summary_en: A one-script solution to run a pre-jailbroken iOS 26.1 virtual iPhone via Tart VM on macOS, with full bootstrap and APT packages included. Launch with a single command and connect via VNC. Ideal for iOS development, testing, and research.

repos.description: A plugin framework on android,Run any third-party apk without installation, modification or repackage
repos.summary_zh: DroidPlugin 是一个 Android 插件框架，支持在不安装、不修改、不重打包第三方 APK 的前提下运行插件应用。它通过代码隔离、资源管理和进程回收机制，实现宿主应用与插件应用的完全解耦，兼容 Android 2.3+，仅需一行代码即可集成，适用于协作开发和动态插件化场景。
repos.summary_en: DroidPlugin is an Android plugin framework enabling the host app to run any third-party APK without installation, modification, or repackaging. It provides complete code and resource isolation, process management, and system API support, requiring only one line of code integration and compatible with Android 2.3+. Ideal for dynamic pluginization and collaborative development.

repos.description: 30 days of React Native demos
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是30天React Native实战教程，涵盖从基础组件到高级动画、手势识别、地图定位、生物识别等22个完整案例，包含iOS原生级交互效果，适合移动端开发学习者系统掌握React Native核心技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a 30-day React Native tutorial series featuring 22 complete demos, covering core components, animations, gestures, maps, biometric authentication, and more. It provides hands-on experience with iOS-level interactions for mobile development learners.

repos.description: A set of web-based tools for generating graphics and other assets that would eventually be in an Android application's res/ directory.
repos.summary_zh: Android Asset Studio 是一个已停止维护的网页工具集，用于生成 Android 应用资源文件（如图标、通知图、九宫格等），现推荐使用 icon.kitchen 或 Android Studio 内置工具替代。
repos.summary_en: The Android Asset Studio was a web-based toolset for generating Android app assets (e.g., icons, notifications, nine-patches). It is no longer maintained; users are advised to switch to icon.kitchen or Android Studio's built-in tools.

repos.description: Flutter Launch Timeline Demo
repos.summary_zh: 该应用是一个基于 Flutter 开发的交互式时间轴应用，展示从宇宙大爆炸到互联网诞生的历史事件。通过精美的动画和垂直滚动时间轴，用户可探索不同时代的关键事件，每个事件配有动态气泡和详细文章页面。核心技术包括 Flutter 框架、Flare 和 Nima 动画库，以及自定义 LeafRenderObjectWidget 实现高性能渲染。
repos.summary_en: This is an interactive vertical timeline app built with Flutter, showcasing historical events from the Big Bang to the Internet. It features animated event bubbles, detailed article pages, and smooth scrolling/zooming. Built using Flutter with Flare and Nima animation libraries, plus custom LeafRenderObjectWidget for high-performance rendering.

repos.description: 这是一个Android系统TTS应用，内置微软演示接口，可自定义HTTP请求，可导入其他本地TTS引擎，以及根据中文双引号的简单旁白/对话识别朗读 ，还有自动重试，备用配置，文本替换等更多功能。
repos.summary_zh: TTS Server 是一款专为 Android 设计的文本转语音应用，集成微软演示接口，支持自定义 HTTP 请求、本地 TTS 引擎导入及基于中文双引号的智能旁白识别朗读，具备自动重试、备用配置和文本替换等高级功能，适用于多场景语音合成需求。
repos.summary_en: TTS Server is an Android-based text-to-speech application featuring Microsoft demo interface integration, customizable HTTP requests, local TTS engine support, and smart narration recognition via Chinese quotation marks. It includes advanced features like auto-retry, fallback configurations, and text replacement for versatile speech synthesis.

repos.description: React Native入门指南
repos.summary_zh: React Native入门指南，系统讲解从环境搭建到组件开发的全流程，涵盖JSX语法、布局设计、UI组件使用及与原生代码集成，适合初学者快速掌握移动端跨平台开发技能。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive React Native tutorial covering fundamentals like JSX, layout design, UI components, and native module integration, designed for developers to master cross-platform mobile app development efficiently.

repos.description: Some Chinese Android Developers Information, 微信公众号:codekk, 网站:
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库整理了中国知名 Android 开发者信息，包含 GitHub 账号、博客链接及个人简介，涵盖源码分析、性能优化、动画开发、开源项目等多个方向，是中文 Android 开发者社区的重要资源集合。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles information about prominent Chinese Android developers, including GitHub profiles, blog links, and professional introductions, covering areas such as source code analysis, performance optimization, animation development, and open-source projects, serving as a key resource for the Chinese Android developer community.

repos.summary_zh: Litter 是 OpenAI Codex 的原生 iOS 与 Android 客户端，支持连接本地或远程服务器，在移动端运行智能体编程工作流。采用 Rust 核心通过 UniFFI 跨平台共享，Swift/Kotlin 仅处理 UI 与平台 API，实现高性能与代码复用。
repos.summary_en: Litter is a native iOS and Android client for OpenAI Codex, enabling users to connect to local or remote servers and run agentic coding workflows on mobile. It shares a single Rust core via UniFFI, keeping platform code (Swift/Kotlin) thin for high performance and code reuse.

repos.description: 一个 Linux.do 第三方客户端
repos.summary_zh: FluxDO 是一款基于 Flutter 框架开发的 Linux.do 社区第三方客户端，覆盖 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 和 Linux 全平台。它采用 Material Design 3 设计语言，集成了 Rust 编写的高性能 DOH（DNS over HTTPS）代理以保障网络安全与防污染，并提供完整的论坛交互、Markdown 编辑及实时消息推送功能。
repos.summary_en: FluxDO is a cross-platform third-party client for the Linux.do community, built with Flutter. It features Material Design 3 and integrates a Rust-based DOH (DNS over HTTPS) proxy for secure, pollution-free networking. The app offers a complete forum experience with Markdown editing, real-time notifications, and native performance across mobile and desktop systems.

repos.description: Some Famous Android Developers Information, 微信公众号:codekk, 网站:
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库整理了全球知名 Android 开发者及其公司信息，涵盖 Google、Square 等核心贡献者的 GitHub 和博客链接，重点展示 Picasso、okhttp、EventBus 等经典开源项目作者，提供开发者影响力与项目关联的权威参考。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles information about renowned Android developers and their companies, featuring core contributors from Google, Square, and others. It highlights authors of iconic open-source projects like Picasso, okhttp, and EventBus, serving as a reference for developer influence and project affiliations.

repos.description: A tab bar that switches between scenes, written in JS for cross-platform support
repos.summary_zh: react-native-tab-navigator 是一个基于 JavaScript 的跨平台标签栏组件，专为 React Native 设计，支持 iOS 和 Android。它允许在多个场景间切换，提供自定义图标、徽章、标题等交互元素，兼容 React Native 0.16+，适用于构建原生级标签导航界面。
repos.summary_en: react-native-tab-navigator is a cross-platform tab bar component written in JavaScript for React Native, supporting iOS and Android. It enables switching between scenes with customizable icons, badges, and titles, compatible with React Native 0.16+. Ideal for building native-like tab navigation interfaces.

repos.summary_zh: litter 是一个原生 iOS 和 Android 客户端，专为 Codex 设计，支持跨平台连接 Mac 设备并通过 SSH 访问 Codex 会话。项目采用 Rust 编写核心模块，使用 UniFFI 实现移动端与 Rust 的桥接，集成音频处理（AEC）和网络发现功能（Bonjour/Tailscale），提供高对比度、无障碍友好的 UI 界面。
repos.summary_en: Litter is a native iOS and Android client for Codex, enabling cross-platform access to Mac-based Codex sessions via SSH. Built with Rust for core logic and UniFFI for mobile bridging, it includes audio processing (AEC), network discovery (Bonjour/Tailscale), and supports accessibility features like high contrast and large text modes.

repos.description: DCloud开源项目集锦
repos.summary_zh: DCloud开源项目合集，涵盖uni-app、uni-app x、uniCloud、UTS等全栈开发框架的示例工程，提供uni-ai x全平台AI聊天套件及uVue语法测试项目，助力开发者快速构建跨平台移动应用与云端一体化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: DCloud's open-source project collection featuring example projects for uni-app, uni-app x, uniCloud, UTS, and more, including the open-source cross-platform AI chat suite uni-ai-x and uVue syntax test project, enabling rapid development of mobile and cloud-integrated applications.

repos.description: 一款白噪音应用送给你，祝您牛掰，有的是钱
repos.summary_zh: XMSLEEP 是一款专注于白噪音播放的 Android 应用，提供雨声、篝火、雷声等多种自然声音，支持音量调节、倒计时、预设播放区域及收藏功能。采用 Material Design 3 和 Jetpack Compose 构建，具备深色模式、动态主题色、无缝循环播放及蓝牙耳机支持，界面简洁流畅，适用于放松、专注和助眠场景。
repos.summary_en: XMSLEEP is an Android app focused on white noise playback, offering natural sounds like rain, fire, thunder, and bird chirps. It supports volume control, countdown timer, preset playlists, favorites, and seamless looping. Built with Jetpack Compose and Material Design 3, it features dark mode, dynamic theming, Coil image loading, and Bluetooth headset support for immersive relaxation, focus, and sleep aid.

repos.description: A news-reading App (MVP+Dagger2+RxJava+Retrofit2+Material Design)
repos.summary_zh: ColorfulNews 是一款基于 MVP 架构的新闻阅读应用，采用 Material Design 风格，集成 Dagger2、RxJava 和 Retrofit2 实现高效的数据绑定与网络请求。支持多频道浏览、图片新闻展示及流畅交互体验，适用于 Android 平台学习与实践。
repos.summary_en: ColorfulNews is a news-reading app built with MVP architecture and Material Design, utilizing Dagger2, RxJava, and Retrofit2 for robust dependency injection, reactive programming, and network communication. It supports multi-channel browsing, image news display, and smooth user interactions, ideal for Android development learning.

repos.description: Diycode每日文章精选
repos.summary_zh: Diycode每日精选是一个技术文章聚合项目，专注于每日精选高质量技术文章并附带点评，覆盖Android开发、React Native、性能优化、架构设计等领域，内容由社区维护并归档，旨在为开发者提供有价值的知识分享与学习资源。
repos.summary_en: Diycode Daily Selection is a curated tech article aggregation project that collects and reviews high-quality technical articles daily, covering Android development, React Native, performance optimization, and architecture. Maintained by the community, it archives content for developers to access valuable knowledge and learning resources.

repos.description: A simple android app to enable Google Location Report, Google Now and related functions in China mainland or somewhere like.
repos.summary_zh: LocationReportEnabler 是一款专为中国大陆用户设计的 Android 应用，通过修改系统参数启用 Google 位置报告、Google Now 及相关功能。支持 ROOT 和 Xposed 框架两种模式，后者更稳定。核心功能包括设置运营商代码和 ISO 国家代码，以绕过地理限制，恢复 Google 服务的时间线功能。
repos.summary_en: LocationReportEnabler is a simple Android app designed to enable Google Location Report, Google Now, and related features in mainland China. It works by setting system properties like gsm.sim.operator.numeric and iso-country to bypass regional restrictions. Available in ROOT and Xposed variants, with the latter recommended for better stability and clarity.

repos.description: AndroidCat安卓书签导航集合
repos.summary_zh: AndroidCat 是一个专为 Android 开发者打造的网址导航集合，涵盖资源文档、技术社区、教程、开源项目等八大类别，提供官方文档、设计指南、开发框架、技术资讯等一站式学习资源，助力开发者高效获取 Android 开发所需工具和知识。
repos.summary_en: AndroidCat is a curated collection of Android development resources, serving as a comprehensive navigation hub for developers. It aggregates official documentation, design guidelines, frameworks, tutorials, open-source projects, and tech communities across eight categories, enabling efficient access to essential tools and knowledge for Android development.

repos.description: :collision::collision::collision:【Flutter版】玩安卓，非常适合学习，代码不多、注释多。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Flutter 开发的玩安卓客户端应用，代码简洁、注释详尽，非常适合 Flutter 初学者学习。项目完整实现了登录注册、首页列表、搜索、侧边栏、WebView 加载、主题切换、状态管理等功能，涵盖常用 UI 组件和状态管理方案，并提供多平台截图与 APK 下载。
repos.summary_en: This is a WanAndroid client app built with Flutter, featuring clean code and extensive comments, ideal for Flutter beginners. It implements core features like login, homepage, search, sidebar, WebView, theme switching, and state management, covering essential UI components and state management patterns, with multi-platform screenshots and APK available.

repos.description: RN 开源之初，写几个Mini-App
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是React Native早期实战项目集合，包含通讯录、LBS附近服务、豆瓣API搜索等Mini-App。涵盖文件系统Node.js服务端、通讯录管理、公告系统、地图定位及Webview集成，提供完整移动端开发范例，适合RN初学者学习全栈移动应用开发。
repos.summary_en: This repository contains early React Native practical projects including address book, LBS nearby services, and Douban API search apps. It covers Node.js file-based backend, contact management, announcements, map positioning, and Webview integration, serving as a comprehensive full-stack mobile development tutorial for RN beginners.

repos.description: 移动端响应式插件
repos.summary_zh: 移动端响应式插件通过transform:scale实现页面缩放适配，支持contain/cover/auto三种模式，兼容iOS4+与Android2.3+等老旧系统。采用视觉稿px单位直接适配，无需rem或媒体查询，零依赖仅1KB，适合单屏滑屏H5页面开发。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight mobile responsive plugin using transform:scale for device adaptation. Supports contain/cover/auto modes with excellent legacy browser support (iOS4+/Android2.3+). Uses visual design px units directly without rem or media queries, ideal for single-screen H5 apps.

repos.description: a sudoku game written in React Native
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个使用 React Native 开发的数独游戏应用，具备动画效果、编辑模式、游戏进度保存及在线排行榜功能。开发者曾创下 3分43秒的解题记录，并计划扩展多难度等级、国际化支持和云端数据存储。
repos.summary_en: A React Native-based Sudoku game featuring animations, editing mode, game resume, and online leaderboards. The developer holds a personal record of 3:43 and plans to add multiple difficulty levels, i18n support, and cloud-based score storage.

repos.description: HiApp written in react-native.
repos.summary_zh: HiApp 是一款基于 React Native 开发的跨平台移动应用，支持 iOS 和 Android 平台。项目提供完整的开发环境配置指南，包含依赖安装、打包器启动及真机运行方案，适合学习 React Native 开发实践。
repos.summary_en: HiApp is a cross-platform mobile application built with React Native, supporting both iOS and Android. It includes setup instructions for dependency installation, packager startup, and device deployment, serving as a practical reference for React Native development.

repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供 Android Design Support Library 的完整教程，包含60分钟实战项目，涵盖 Snackbar、FloatingActionButton、NavigationView 等核心组件的集成与交互实现，适合 Android 开发者学习现代 UI 设计模式。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive 60-minute codelab tutorial on the Android Design Support Library, demonstrating integration of key UI components like Snackbar, FloatingActionButton, and NavigationView to build modern Android interfaces with Material Design principles.

repos.description: The unofficial V2EX app for iOS
repos.summary_zh: darkerk/v2ex 是一款专为 iOS 平台开发的非官方 V2EX 客户端应用，采用 Swift 4.1 编写，支持 iOS 10.0+。该应用提供简洁的界面设计，让用户能够便捷地浏览 V2EX 社区内容，包括节点、主题和评论等核心功能，是 V2EX 用户的移动端优质替代方案。
repos.summary_en: darkerk/v2ex is an unofficial iOS app for V2EX, built with Swift 4.1 and compatible with iOS 10.0+. It offers a clean interface for browsing V2EX content, including nodes, topics, and comments, serving as a convenient mobile alternative to the web version of V2EX.

repos.description: Independent iOS client for Lody — native chat, sessions, and coding-agent collaboration on iPhone
repos.summary_zh: 独立开源 iOS 客户端，为 Lody AI 协作平台打造。采用 React Native + Swift 6.0 混合架构，结合 CRDT 数据同步，支持无限聊天、流式文本渲染、代码 Diff 高亮与文件树导航，严格遵循 Apple HIG，提供安全的本地会话与远程服务桥接体验。
repos.summary_en: Independent open-source iOS client for Lody AI platform. Hybrid React Native + Swift 6.0 architecture with CRDT sync (Loro/Flock). Features infinite chat, streaming rendering, code diff highlighting, and file tree. Strictly follows Apple HIG for authentic native experience bridging local sessions and remote services.

repos.description: 爱V2EX（原掌上V2EX）
repos.summary_zh: 爱V2EX是一款非官方的V2EX社区Android客户端，提供话题浏览、节点搜索、用户资料查看、话题创建与回复、未读提醒等功能，支持滑动手势操作，界面简洁易用，完全开源并遵循GPL协议。
repos.summary_en: V2EX-android is a non-official Android client for the V2EX community, offering features like topic browsing, node search, user profiles, topic creation/replies, and unread notifications. It supports gesture navigation and is fully open-source under the GPL license.

repos.description: A v2ex client on android platform.(deprecated)
repos.summary_zh: v2ex-daily-android 是一款已停止维护的 Android 客户端应用，专为访问 v2ex 社区设计，支持浏览主题、节点搜索和用户信息查看，界面遵循 Material Design 风格，提供简洁高效的原生体验。
repos.summary_en: v2ex-daily-android is a deprecated Android client for the v2ex community, offering topic browsing, node search, and user profiles with a clean Material Design interface, optimized for native mobile experience.

repos.description: Urban governance - Where is the restroom?
repos.summary_zh: 该应用为解决城市如厕难问题，提供附近2公里内卫生间实时搜索、导航及基础信息查询，集成地图、天气、文章推荐等功能，采用高德地图、七牛云存储、微信公众号及阿里云部署，展示如何快速构建实用型移动应用。
repos.summary_en: This app addresses urban restroom accessibility by enabling users to search nearby toilets within 2km, view basic info, and get navigation. It integrates map services, weather, articles, and uses platforms like Amap, Qiniu Cloud, WeChat, and Aliyun for rapid deployment of a practical mobile solution.

repos.description: 📚《Flutter 入门指南》
repos.summary_zh: 《Flutter 入门指南》是一本系统介绍 Flutter 跨平台开发框架的电子书，涵盖 Dart 语言、Skia 图形引擎及 Material Design UI 开发。适合有 JavaScript 基础的前端开发者快速掌握移动端、Web 和桌面端应用开发技能。
repos.summary_en: 《Flutter 入门指南》is a comprehensive guide to Flutter, covering Dart language, Skia graphics engine, and Material Design UI development for cross-platform apps (mobile, web, desktop). Ideal for frontend developers with JavaScript background.

repos.description: Android Client for Carbon Forum with Material Design.
repos.summary_zh: Android-Carbon-Forum 是一个基于 Material Design 的 Carbon Forum 论坛 Android 客户端，提供流畅的移动端浏览体验，支持主题查看、发帖、登录、通知推送等功能，采用模块化架构便于二次开发和定制部署。
repos.summary_en: Android-Carbon-Forum is an Android client for Carbon Forum built with Material Design, offering seamless mobile browsing, topic viewing, posting, login, and push notifications. It features a modular architecture for easy customization and deployment.

repos.description: 利用reactnative技术，开发，生成app
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是一个基于 React Native 开发的移动端应用 demo，参考淘宝手机端 UI 设计，实现了包含首页、微淘、社区、购物车、个人中心等模块的 TabBar 界面。支持图标切换、角标提醒等功能，展示了 React Native 在跨平台 App 开发中的高效性和前端开发者上手友好的特点。
repos.summary_en: This project is a React Native-based mobile app demo, inspired by Taobao's mobile interface. It features a TabBar with modules like Home, Weitao, Community, Cart, and Profile, supporting icon switching and badge notifications. It demonstrates React Native's efficiency in cross-platform development and ease of use for frontend developers.
